text:
Anna (Docs): hey team — i'm opening a docs PR to tidy up rate limits / quotas / billing examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/893

Mike (PM): thanks anna. two quick asks: 1) include a short migration note for v1->v2 quota header/name changes, 2) add an explicit example showing reserved_capacity vs burst behavior (1-2 curl calls) :+1:

Sarah (Eng): noted. the runtime changed the header name last week from `X-Redwood-Quota` to `X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining`. i'll paste curl + python sdk snippets showing both current and legacy headers so customers can detect config drift.

Anna (Docs): perfect. also can we add an example snippet for how per-route metering shows up in the console? leo, can you share a permalink to a sample dashboard or a sanitized mock?

Leo (Analytics): i can add a sanitized permalink and a screenshot. we should avoid exposing internal org ids — i'll provide a dashboard URL template and a screenshot hosted in the PR branch. example link (replace ids): `https://console.redwood.io/dashboards/usage/tiers?start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-07&org=REDACTED`

Mike (PM): also add a tiny section on "billing tiers and throttle behavior" — e.g., free tier: burst up to 20 rps, then token-based throttling; reserved: guaranteed throughput + queueing policy. a short table is enough.

Anna (Docs): agreed. i'll draft the table and the migration checklist. Sarah, for the SDK migration snippet, can you confirm method names changed in the python sdk (Client.get_quota -> client.get_quota_status)? i want to avoid breaking examples.

Sarah (Eng): yes, method renamed to `get_quota_status()` in python SDK v2. we'll keep a tiny compatibility snippet:

```python
# v1 compatibility shim
try:
    status = client.get_quota_status()
except AttributeError:
    status = client.get_quota()
```

Anna (Docs): nice. i'll include that under "Migration notes". also cleaning up two broken links i found in the pricing page — one to the old metering faq and one to an internal spreadsheet. i'll replace with the dashboard template + public metering FAQ: https://docs.redwood.ai/metering-faq (stub)

Leo (Analytics): for the console examples, can we show a per-route token breakdown and an example of the "cost by model" widget? i'll export a CSV sample and attach under `assets/` in the PR for the docs.

Anna (Docs): that'd be great. assets/screenshots + csv will help reviewers. docs-bot, will you post a deploy preview once PR is up?

docs-bot: deploy-preview created — https://deploy-preview-893--docs.redwood.ai (live for 30 minutes) :rocket:

Mike (PM): one more: add a short FAQ entry: "why do my quota headers differ between dedicated and hosted?" — answer: hosted normalizes header names, dedicated preserves customer-configured policy names; link to infra note.

Anna (Docs): adding that. i'll ping for reviews when the PR has code + assets + deploy preview. target to merge by EOD tomorrow. thanks all :sparkles:

Sarah (Eng): i'll post the curl + python snippets in the PR in 30m.

Leo (Analytics): uploading sanitized dashboard screenshot and sample CSV to the PR now.

Mike (PM): LGTM once snippets + table + FAQ are in.

Anna (Docs): cool — i'll assign reviewers: @mike, @sarah, @leo. closing loop here and will update thread with PR link once assets are attached.
